text: The subject Hamid Shah holds account PK**BAHL****5384 opened on 25 January 2020. The declared occupation is Medical sales officer (salaried) with a declared monthly income of PKR 220,000 per month. During the activity window of 1 May 2026 to 25 May 2026 the account recorded 14 credits totalling PKR 18,216,000 and 4 debits totalling PKR 14,854,000. The activity comprised 13 cash deposits totalling PKR 17,996,000 made across 4 branches (Clifton Branch, DHA Phase 6 Branch, Gulshan-e-Iqbal Branch, Saddar Branch). The activity was flagged by Tazama on 25 May 2026, with the Tazama typology STR-PK-01 scoring 320 against a threshold of 300. Nine of the 13 cash deposits (69%) were between PKR 1,600,000 and PKR 1,999,999, i.e., just below the cash transaction reporting threshold of PKR 2,000,000, consistent with structuring. More than one cash deposit occurred on two days (11 May 2026, 25 May 2026), matching the structuring red flag of multiple same‑day deposits. Credits in the window were 82.8 times the declared monthly income of PKR 220,000 per month, indicating cash volume inconsistent with declared income, a structuring indicator. Overall, the pattern of frequent near‑threshold cash deposits across multiple branches, combined with the disparity to the declared income of PKR 220,000 per month and the reporting threshold of PKR 2,000,000, is consistent with suspected structuring. PKR 7,434,000 was transferred to Sheraz Traders (PK**SHER****1518, Synthetic Bank A) in two transactions. PKR 7,420,000 was transferred to Crescent Imports (PK**CRES****1592, Synthetic Bank A) in two transactions. Debits equal to 82% of credits were made, with a median of 15.3 hours between the latest credit and each debit. Screening on 28 May 2026 found no match on sanctions, PEP or adverse‑media lists. The account was placed under enhanced monitoring pending the reporting decision, with no contact made with the customer about this review.
